states.description: Person is eating a meal at the desk.

triggers: Person has finished eating and an empty bowl is on the table.
Person is resting hands on the table with an empty bowl nearby.
Person is sitting at the desk with an empty bowl in front of them.
rules.action: Pick up the bowl and place it in the dishwasher.
